name: confetto
description: Voice mock interviews for medical school, residency, PA, dental, nursing and other health programs, with an AI interviewer and rubric-scored feedback.

interface.longDescription:
Practice your medical school, residency or health-program interview out loud with a realistic AI interviewer, right in ChatGPT.

Ask for a mock interview and Confetto picks a question for your program (MMI ethics, personal, policy, teamwork and more), or choose one from the question bank. Tap Start and answer by voice: the interviewer asks natural follow-ups like a real admissions panel. When you finish, Confetto scores your answer against an admissions rubric and shows what went well, what to improve and a full breakdown, and ChatGPT can coach you on it.

Works for medical school (MD/DO, MMI and traditional), residency (including CaRMS), PA, dental, vet, nursing, pharmacy, PT and OT programs. Your interviews and feedback stay in your Confetto account at app.confetto.ai.
defaultPrompt: Give me a medical school mock interview
Practice an MMI ethics station with me
How did my last mock interview go?

positive.description: Start a voice mock interview for the user's program.
positive.prompt: Give me a medical school mock interview.
positive.expected_behavior: A Confetto panel shows a question, about 8 minutes, and a Start button. Tapping Start opens the fullscreen voice room; after the microphone is allowed, the AI interviewer speaks first and asks follow-ups.

positive.description: Find practice questions by topic and practice one.
positive.prompt: Find me MMI ethics questions about patient autonomy.
positive.expected_behavior: The panel lists matching questions with topic chips and Practice buttons. Tapping Practice sets up that question as a mock interview (start_mock_interview).

positive.description: Finish an interview and get scored feedback.
positive.prompt: Start a mock interview, answer by voice for about a minute, tap End interview, then Finish & get feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: The room shows 'Scoring your interview…', then the full results. Back in chat the panel shows a score out of 100 with a label, a rubric breakdown, what went well, what to improve and a model answer, and ChatGPT summarizes them.

positive.prompt: How have my Confetto mock interviews gone?
positive.expected_behavior: The panel lists recent interviews with dates and colored scores. Tapping one opens its feedback (get_interview_feedback).

positive.description: Practice the Casper situational judgment test.
positive.prompt: Help me practice for the Casper test.
positive.expected_behavior: The panel shows a quick Casper practice set (video and typed scenarios, timed). Start opens it fullscreen; after answering, results show an average score out of 9, an estimated quartile, section and competency scores and feedback per scenario.

negative.description: Asking ChatGPT to answer the interview question for the user. ChatGPT may coach in general terms but doesn't run the user's interview for them; nothing is created.
negative.prompt: Answer this MMI question for me so I can memorize it.

negative.description: Feedback for an interview that doesn't exist or belongs to someone else: 'No interview with that id for this user', no data from other accounts.
